answer: In 2023–24, 2,208 LEAs were surveyed and 1,579 responses were recorded—about 72%. Excluding 385 LEAs that did not offer TK, 1,823 remained, making the stated response rate 87%. In 2024–25, 1,464 LEAs were surveyed and 952 responses were recorded—about 65%. Excluding 26 LEAs that did not offer TK, 926 remained, making the stated response rate 95%. Thus, 2024–25 had 744 fewer LEAs surveyed, 627 fewer responses, a 7-percentage-point lower overall stated rate, but an 8-point higher stated rate after excluding non-TK LEAs.
